concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-fraud-protection-node]] - Node.js `transaction_reviewed` notification for an accepted or rejected Fraud Protection Dashboard review, with requested-not-completed void/refund scope and review payload categories
warnings: Keep the trigger specific to a transaction cited for Review in the Fraud Protection Dashboard and then accepted or rejected; do not infer coverage of every transaction, fraud decision, product, payment method, or merchant.
Preserve `has been requested` for a rejected transaction's void or refund; do not claim completion, success, settlement, or payment finality.
The Attributes section provides concatenated categories without visible field names; do not invent attribute identifiers or a complete payload schema.
Do not infer review automation, webhook delivery timing, retry, ordering, duplicate handling, or universal fraud-protection availability from this event reference.
